description: Check contrast between two colors using WCAG 2.x luminance ratio, APCA Lc (WCAG 3 draft), or both. Also checks color-blindness contrast drops and suggests an exact hue-preserving fix if contrast fails.

algorithm.description: Contrast algorithm: 'wcag' (WCAG 2.x ratio), 'apca' (Lc, WCAG 3 draft), or 'both'

suggestFix.description: Include nearest hue-preserving AA fix and CVD/optical warnings when issues exist

name: check_contrast
